title: Shape selective cracking of polypropylene on an H-MFI type zeolite catalyst with recovery of cyclooctane solvent
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, 3,890-903
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00484A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Tomohiro Fukumasa, Yuya Kawatani, Hiroki Masuda, Ikuto Nakashita, Ryusei Hashiguchi, Masanori Takemoto, Satoshi Suganuma, Etsushi Tsuji, Toru Wakaihara, Naonobu Katada
Polyolefin was selectively cracked in the micropores of an MFI-zeolite catalyst, while the solvent, cyclooctane with bulky a molecular shape, was mostly recovered. It opens a way for chemical recycling of plastic without consuming other materials.
